title: Who’s Asking? Evaluating LLM Robustness to Inquiry Personas in Factual Question Answering
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating the robustness of LLM responses to user-disclosed personas in factual question answering. Although it employs a 'Stereotype Risk' metric and identifies ethical-related refusal patterns as failure modes, it does not explicitly evaluate or benchmark religion, spiritual traditions, or moral/ethical frameworks. It deliberately uses neutral personas and focuses on objective knowledge.
